candidates.summary: Post: 'Introducing Claude Meetings: add Claude to your team's video call and it builds docs, whiteboards, and other artifacts with you while you're still talking.' Rolling out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans.
facts: A follow-up post says a lot of getting good work out of Claude is finding the missing context, and that Claude Meetings has been very useful internally.

candidates.summary: Post: 'A lot of getting good work out of Claude now is just finding the context it's missing and figuring out how to close that gap. Claude Meetings is one way to bring in the remaining slices and has proved very useful internally.'

Post: 'Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents is now in private beta. You can host the agent harness, sandboxes, and session history, in your own cloud or on-premises, and choose where requests to Claude are sent.'

Post: new video where two Anthropic speakers discuss how new models launch on the API and the features that ship with them, plus how to rethink your harness and measure cost per task when you upgrade to a new model.

Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 'Meet Gemini 4 Hydrogen: built for rapid coding, multimodal synthesis, and everyday workflows. It finishes tasks 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash and surpasses Argon on the @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index.'
facts: Companion post: Gemini 4 Hydrogen has 4 thinking levels, follows Carbon and Argon, and finishes tasks 2.5x faster than 3.8 Flash.
Sundar-lane post: 'Very excited to release Gemini 4 Hydrogen! Incredible speed and intelligence for everyday coding, agentic work and all-round use.'

candidates.summary: Post: 'Gemini 4 Hydrogen is now available in Cursor! At its default effort, it scores 54.3% on CursorBench, up from 39.6% for Gemini 3.8 Flash.'
